newsitem.title: POLAND: Bank Slaski sets up separate broking unit.
newsitem.headline: Bank Slaski sets up separate broking unit.

text.p: Polish Bank Slaski SA set up its securities operations in a separate broking subsidiary, the bank said in a statement on Monday.
Slaski said it took 139,998 or more than 99.99 percent of the 140,000 shares of the new company representing a share capital of 2,799,960 zlotys.
The bank's move was in line with the Polish Securities Commission (KPW) recommendation that bank-owned brokerages should operate as separate legal as well as financial and operational entitites.
